text_block_list.text:
That was fine steering! You might just 
have the makings of a helmsman, you know?
choice_data_list: All that matters is that they liked it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, absolutely! Every single one is a 
top-tier treasure. Everyone's burning with 
ambition—what great expressions!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Every time I look upon these, it will 
remind me— that without fail, I too will 
carve my name into history!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Once we're back, let's display them all in 
my room! HAHAHAHAHA!!
